newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Foster & Co target of suit - attorneys.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Foster & Co target of suit - attorneys.

text.p: Attorneys for purchasers of securities through the retail brokerage firm Sterling Foster & Co Inc in several public offerings during an almost two-year period said a class action suit was filed against the firm.
The complaint alleges the firm, the president and controlling shareholder Adam Lieberman, and others of manipulating the price of securities it offered.

The complaint alleges that Sterling Foster, prior to the public offerings, entered into undisclosed agreements with certain shareholders' to purchase all or large portions of their stock at prices well below the offering price.
According to a press release, the offerings occurred between Oct. 17, 1994 and Sept. 3, 1996.
